note: Drive Like a Local: Florida (GTA 6 tie-in). US federal MUTCD signs, which Florida uses with state supplements. Titles confirmed from the runner's DISCOVER.txt and sources.json (rev 1 fetch, 26 Oct 2026), all public domain (FHWA / DelDot). R2-1 is the Commons file as drawn (it reads 50): episodes that need another limit use the numbered Commons file of that limit (R2-1-45 etc.), never a number over a blank sign. FL-MOVEOVER is the FDOT sign file found by the discover query: its licence is read by the fetch (sources.json); fl03 shows it only if the fetch brings it with a free licence. No toll sign: no Commons file in DISCOVER.txt shows an open-road toll gantry sign without a toll-programme name, so the gantry carries none.
